subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should trusted after_compaction hook subscribers receive a supported current-session resetSession(reason?) API as part of the plugin hook contract?
rationale: Current main has no such plugin API, and accepting it establishes a compatibility-sensitive session-lifecycle capability even though the implementation is narrower than the rejected arbitrary-key proposal.

options.title: Approve the narrow API
options.body: Accept current-session-only reset after successful compaction, contingent on the two patch fixes and complete live lifecycle proof.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Reject the plugin API and keep session rotation owned entirely by core or a more generic future lifecycle-action contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow API
recommendation.body: Accept current-session-only reset after successful compaction, contingent on the two patch fixes and complete live lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available provenance ties this person to current session reset lifecycle behavior and the relevant plugin/core boundary.
